full_prompt_en: A square ink-and-wash landscape presents five small black birds rising above a rugged dark slope on warm ochre paper. The left side is relatively open, its golden surface carrying faint stains, fine scratches and uneven paper texture. A dense blue-black cloud enters from the top and right edges, filling the upper-right corner. Its irregular lower edge narrows towards the middle of the image, where softer teal-grey washes and detached dark flecks dissolve into the warm ground. The birds occupy the diagonal gap between the slope and this descending ink mass. Two close silhouettes sit just above the left ridge, another pair is staggered lower and farther right, and a higher bird appears nearer the central edge of the cloud. Their spread wings form distinct angular shapes against the ochre field. The rocky foreground rises at the left edge and descends towards the lower right in broad uneven shelves. Nearly black recesses alternate with dry brown and grey brushwork, bringing out broken ledges and rough surfaces. Thin upright stalks appear on the crest at the far left. Narrow rusty-orange accents and horizontal strokes stretch across the lower middle, with the solid forms gradually thinning into the pale paper towards the right. The heavy foreground and upper cloud frame a lighter central opening around the flight of birds. Wet, feathered edges in the cloud contrast with dry, layered marks across the slope and the sharper bird silhouettes. Illumination is diffuse, with no visible sun or distinct cast shadow; the light comes from the exposed golden paper and translucent warm washes. The overall image combines weighty blue-black forms, earth-toned texture and spare moving silhouettes in a diagonal, atmospheric composition.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形水墨淡彩山景，五只黑色小鸟在暖赭色纸面上飞离崎岖暗坡。左侧空间相对开阔，金黄色底面带有淡淡色渍、细痕和不均匀纸纹。浓重蓝黑墨云从顶部和右边缘进入，占据右上角；不规则下缘朝画面中部逐渐收窄，柔软青灰晕染和分散墨点在此消融进暖色底面。飞鸟分布在岩坡与向下延伸的墨团之间的斜向空隙里。两道紧邻的剪影位于左侧山脊上方，另一对高低错落地出现在更靠右下的位置，还有一只较高的鸟靠近墨云的中央边缘。展开的翅膀在赭色底上形成清楚而有棱角的形状。岩石前景在左边缘隆起，以宽阔、不规则的台阶状层面向右下方降低。近黑色凹部与干涩棕灰笔触交替，表现断裂岩层和粗糙表面。最左侧坡顶有细小竖向草茎。窄锈橙色点缀及水平笔痕横过下部中央，实体形态向右渐薄，融入浅色纸面。厚重前景与上方墨云围出较明亮的中央空处，让飞鸟从中穿过。墨云湿润羽化的边缘与岩坡干笔层次、飞鸟清晰剪影形成对照。光线漫散，没有可见太阳或明确投影，亮度来自露出的金黄纸底与半透明暖色水痕。整幅画以厚重蓝黑形体、土色肌理和疏朗飞鸟构成斜向展开、富有氛围的画面。
style_prompt_en: The style is formed by fluid ink diffusion, dry textured strokes, and visible warm paper. Dense dark shapes break into soft-edged stains and scattered droplets, creating a shift from weight to openness. Charcoal blue-black carries the strongest contrast, while muted ochre and brown remain visible beneath translucent washes. Small crisp marks stand apart from hazier masses, giving the image a varied edge quality. The composition often rises diagonally from a concentrated dark area into a lighter open field. Diffuse light and restrained colour let texture, tonal spacing, and directional movement define the visual character.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格由流动的墨色晕染、干涩肌理笔触和可见暖纸底色构成。浓重暗形逐渐裂解为柔边墨迹和散落墨点，在厚重与空阔之间形成变化。炭蓝黑承担最强反差，含蓄的赭色与棕色则透过半透明墨层显现。少量清晰短笔触从朦胧墨团中分离出来，形成不同的边缘质感。构图常由集中的暗部沿斜向升入较明亮的开放区域。漫射光和克制色彩让肌理、色调间距与方向动势共同构成视觉特征。
theme_en: Black ink cloud and birds above a dark rocky slope
theme_zh: 深色岩坡上升的墨云与飞鸟
name: Bada Shanren
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
